what: Graded golden runs (EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=1) disable+clear the program cache per test, so any LOOSE_CASE with extras.trace fails at begin_trace_capture (TT_FATAL mesh_workload.cpp:617, binaries not in program cache) for every op; tests that raise before dispatch (validation-error regression tests) fail with peak_total=0. Shows up as a supported_fail the op cannot fix, and every verifier must re-derive this by running twice.
suggest: Skip L1 capture (or keep the program cache on) for trace cells and for tests that never dispatch; until then, note in the verifier prompt that trace/validation failures under L1 capture are harness-side and to confirm with EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=0.

what: Drift handling only covers over-claims and XPASS. An under-claim (kernel already handles a TARGET value but validate() refuses it) never surfaces in verify_supported: the cell is a clean xfail_expected, so it stays queued as refinement work. Here fp32 TILE worked bit-exactly at Phase 0 and was left refused by the first verifier pass.
suggest: Add a step: for each TARGET - SUPPORTED value whose kernel path already exists, probe the golden cells with validate() bypassed, and widen SUPPORTED when they pass and the spec pairing rules allow it.
